inferences: The visible Run failure may be related to Window Walker processing an open-window record, but the discussion does not prove that the marked UI state and exception are the same event.
issue_context.analysis: The diagnostic narrows the relevant plugin and code path, so a generic request for another ZIP would be wasteful. The missing interaction sequence is still needed to connect the exception to the visible symptom and to build a focused regression test.
initial_investigation: src/modules/launcher/Plugins/Microsoft.Plugin.WindowWalker/Components/SearchController.cs dereferences window.Title and window.Process.Name inside FuzzySearchOpenWindows.
The live issue remains unassigned and has no linked duplicate or fix.
